review.description: Against main, S4/S5 add hosted setup timing, atomic initial publication and reservation-backed missing-file recovery with truthful partial outcomes. Cycle4 corrects the prose and mapping quantifier: reconstruction requires a valid matching reservation and does not replace an existing path, including a broken symlink. This documentation correction adds no new behavior; normal finalization of selected existing journals remains unchanged.
review.implementation: Read materialize_reserved: reconstruction is attempted only when the selected path is absent and not a symlink, then checks exact selected results path, reserved filename, finite numeric clock, exact typed options and hosted origin. Existing selected journals return to normal setup/overall finalization without a new schema-validation promise. Journal.create still writes complete JSON through owned staging before replace; workflow still exports selection, starts setup before metadata, finalizes before artifacts and uploads one selected file. Full tracked-file identity proof confirms runtime, tests and workflow are unchanged from270e84a. The whole main comparison remains behavior because the original meaningful implementation/test cochanges are retained.
review.tests: Read test_hosted_recovery_rejects_unknown_reservations_and_preserves_existing_files and ran it successfully: absent evidence is not created for missing, malformed, mismatched or ill-typed reservations; the exact empty and invalid-JSON strings remain unchanged after both finalizers; the broken symlink remains a symlink with no target. These assertions do not claim preservation of all structurally corrupt or foreign parseable JSON. Existing real SIGINT/SIGTERM partial-write and metadata tests, ordinary-write-failure assertions and workflow-order test remain byte-identical. Required full fixture reconciliation and separate local CI will rerun them; no text-mirroring test or real-host acceptance is added.
